## Profile

I am an interdisciplinary biochemist with experience spanning molecular biology, analytical biochemistry, bioanalytical research, and plant biotechnology. My work combines laboratory experimentation with analytical instrumentation and computational approaches.

## Education

**MSc in Biochemistry — Mahatma Gandhi University**

**Master’s thesis:** *Isolation of Fluoride Resistant Microorganisms from Fluoride Contaminated Ground Water Samples of Nalgonda District and Their Role in Bioremediation.*

## Professional experience

- **Project Associate-II — University of Hyderabad**, working in Dr. Ajay W. Tumaney’s laboratory.
- **Member, Review Board — Acta Scientific Publications Private Limited.**
- **Project Associate-I — CSIR-Indian Institute of Chemical Sciences / IICT.**
- **Research Associate-I — Axis Clinicals Ltd., Bioanalytical Department.**

## Research philosophy

I enjoy interdisciplinary projects combining wet-lab biology, advanced analytical instrumentation, and dry-lab interpretation.
